title: Theory of Propagation of Elastic Waves in a Fluid-Saturated Porous Solid. I. Low-Frequency Range
journal: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America
primary_contribution: Develops a low-frequency theory of stress-wave propagation in fluid-saturated porous solids and identifies two dilatational modes and one rotational mode with phase-velocity dispersion and attenuation.
notes: AIP page: JASA 28(2), 168-178 (1956); abstract read. The publisher marks the article available to purchase. Drive DOI search found citation-bearing files only, not this article. ASCII hyphens normalize the publisher hyphens.

title: Theory of Propagation of Elastic Waves in a Fluid-Saturated Porous Solid. II. Higher Frequency Range
journal: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America
primary_contribution: Extends the porous-solid wave theory beyond the Poiseuille-flow limit and analyzes frequency-dependent phase and group velocities and attenuation for rotational and dilatational modes, including high-frequency behavior.
notes: AIP page: JASA 28(2), 179-191 (1956); abstract read. The publisher marks the article available to purchase. Drive DOI search found citation-bearing files only, not this article. ASCII hyphens normalize the publisher hyphens.

title: Mechanics of Deformation and Acoustic Propagation in Porous Media
primary_contribution: Presents a unified poroelastic formulation for deformation and acoustic propagation, extending the wave theory to anisotropy, solid dissipation, and additional relaxation effects.
notes: AIP page: Journal of Applied Physics 33(4), 1482-1498 (1962); abstract read; full text marked available to purchase. Its reference list cites both 1956 JASA parts.

title: Wave propagation in thermoelastic saturated porous medium
primary_contribution: Modifies Biot wave theory to include thermoelastic coupling in saturated poroelastic media, deriving four plane-wave modes and computing longitudinal-wave velocities and attenuation.
notes: Springer gives volume 117, pages 951-958 (2008) and an online publication date of 06 May 2009; journal year 2008 used. Abstract read; full text is subscription content. Drive citation-chain check found the work in a verified 2023 paper reference list.

title: Physics and Simulation of Wave Propagation in Linear Thermoporoelastic Media
full_authors: Jose M. Carcione; Fabio Cavallini; Enjiang Wang; Jing Ba; Li-Yun Fu
journal: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
primary_contribution: Develops numerical simulation of linear nonisothermal poroelastic waves from Biot theory and generalized heat transport, identifying classical P/S waves plus Biot and thermal slow modes and proposing explicit time-stepping methods.
notes: Wiley/AGU page: JGR: Solid Earth 124(8), 8147-8166 (2019); abstract read and page marked Free Access with full-text/PDF links. A verified 2023 Drive paper cites the Carcione thermo-poroelastic simulation line.

title: Causality and the Dispersion Relation: Logical Foundations
primary_contribution: Proves for general linear systems that strict causality and a dispersion relation are logically equivalent, deriving frequency-domain analyticity rather than assuming it.
notes: APS page and citation export verify Physical Review 104(6), 1760-1770 (1956); abstract read. The full PDF requires authorization; no matching Drive PDF found.

title: Dispersive body waves
primary_contribution: Derives Kramers-Kronig-type dispersion equations linking attenuation and dispersion in linear body waves as a consequence of causality, and discusses phase and group velocities.
notes: Direct AGU/Wiley page verifies JGR 67(13), 5279-5291 (1962); abstract read. The DOI resolver initially showed a challenge, but the direct AGU page opened. The PDF link did not yield full text; no matching Drive PDF found.

title: Linear Models of Dissipation whose Q is almost Frequency Independent-II
journal: Geophysical Journal of the Royal Astronomical Society
primary_contribution: Introduces fractional derivatives into the stress-strain relation to model nearly frequency-independent Q, treats plane waves and free torsional modes, and checks the model against Earth and laboratory observations.
notes: Wiley page verifies volume 13, issue 5, pages 529-539 (1967); publisher Summary (abstract) read. title: Constant Q-wave propagation and attenuation
journal: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
primary_contribution: Presents a linear attenuation model with frequency-independent Q, derives the associated power-law phase velocity and pulse-scaling relations, and applies them to field observations.
notes: Wiley/AGU page verifies JGR: Solid Earth 84(B9), 4737-4748 (1979); abstract read. The PDF link returned the abstract page rather than full text; no matching Drive PDF found.

title: Applications of Fractional Calculus to the Theory of Viscoelasticity
primary_contribution: Connects fractional calculus with Abel integral equations for materials with memory, deriving Mittag-Leffler creep and relaxation functions and a continuous solid-to-fluid transition.
notes: ASME page verifies Journal of Applied Mechanics 51(2), 299-307 (1984); abstract read. Full article is purchase-only. A verified Drive paper cites Koeller 1984; Drive DOI search found only citation-bearing material, not the target article.
